idea-plugin.name: Demystified Stack Trace Links
idea-plugin.description:
Makes file:line fragments inside Ben.Demystifier-formatted (Serilog WithDemystifiedStackTraces) exception frames clickable in Rider's Run/Debug/Terminal console, even when the surrounding method signature does not match the built-in Stack Trace Explorer grammar.

Also watches the clipboard and automatically triggers Rider's built-in "Analyze Stack Trace or Thread Dump" action (id Unscramble) as soon as something that looks like an exception stack trace is copied -- Rider does not do this on its own.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Fix: clipboard-triggered auto-open now uses ActionUtil.invokeAction (the platform-recommended way to programmatically fire an action, including its update/enable check) instead of calling actionPerformed directly, which could silently no-op.
  • Confirmed via IntelliJ Platform source that the action id for "Analyze Stack Trace or Thread Dump" is Unscramble on all JetBrains IDEs, including Rider.

1.1.1

  • Fix: corrected interface name to CopyPasteManager.ContentChangedListener.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: clickable file:line links for demystified stack traces in Run/Debug/Terminal consoles.
